significance: A Divya Desam near Kanchipuram believed to have been built by 13th-century Pandya kings, with later Chola and Thanjavur Nayak contributions. Rama is worshipped here as the victorious Vijayaraghava, and the temple is glorified in the Nalayira Divya Prabandham.
story: Rama is said to have performed the funeral rites of the eagle-king Jatayu, who fell defending Sita, at the pit (kuzhi) that names this place.
